name: Antoine Massip
bio: Antoine Massip is a French aspiring screenwriter based in Brussels. A business school graduate in Marketing, he has worked in the film industry, notably in film distribution and product placement. He has appeared in several international films and television series. Passionate about storytelling, he is also developing his own film projects as a writer.

credits.title: The Riders
credits.overview: Fred Scully is a family man who has bought a farmhouse in Ireland and is renovating it while his wife Jennifer and their 7-year-old daughter Billie are on a trip to their homeland in Australia. After his wife disappears during the trip, Fred and his traumatized daughter must travel across Europe searching for answers.

credits.title: The Royal Nannies
credits.overview: Carter is tasked with serving as both nanny and protector to Princess Isabella while the King and Queen are away on a trade mission. Under the guardianship of her uncle, Prince Theo, the family is faced with unexpected challenges, and as Carter and Theo grow closer, she finds herself torn between love and duty.
